summary: Gold Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) furnishing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 operating and financial results via press release dated November 4, 2026. Highlights include record quarterly revenue of $10.2 million (up ~147% year over year), Total Revenue, Land Agreement Proceeds and Interest of $11.5 million, Adjusted EBITDA of $9.0 million, 2,689 GEOs, and $21.0 million cash with no debt drawn on a $125 million revolver. The release notes small royalty acquisitions on Sterling and Granite Creek for $0.8 million. No special-situation corporate event is disclosed; this is a routine earnings filing, with portfolio production growth as the watch item.
